distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Guizhou, Sichuan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence.

host_note: Current promoted hosts remain Millettia, Fagus, Symplocos and Betula from Smith et al. (2020). Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Fagus crenata and Symplocos prunifolia from Japan; because these are explicitly non-China host records, they are retained only as source context and are not promoted into the China host synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborinus schaufussi (Blandford, 1894).
